npcs.name: Tovin Brassbarrow
npcs.description: General Store Owner associated with Brassbarrow General.
npcs.biography: Tovin Brassbarrow works as a general store owner out of Brassbarrow General, a 121-year-old Dwarf with more town memory than most council minutes. Tovin taps the ledger thrice before he trusts a total, and is rarely without brass abacus older than the shop sign. Father to Lina; debtor to Marrow. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to hand a debt-free shop to Lina. What keeps them careful is losing the store to Marrow's interest rates. To a DM, Tovin is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. A crate labeled nails arrived full of locked strongbox parts.

npcs.name: Lina Brassbarrow
npcs.description: Shop Clerk associated with the shop counter.
npcs.biography: Most days begin the same for Lina Brassbarrow: a 98-year-old Dwarf shop clerk moving through the shop counter as if the stones themselves keep appointments with them. Lina corrects prices under her breath in Khuzdul, and is rarely without ink-stained apron with secret pockets for disputed notes. Tovin's daughter and clerk. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to modernize inventory before the autumn fair. What keeps them careful is her father making another handshake loan. To a DM, Lina is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Matched a pawn ticket description to a ring Lysa Thorne tried to sell quietly.

npcs.name: Marrow Cline
npcs.description: Moneylender associated with a narrow credit office above the grain street.
npcs.biography: Ask around town for a moneylender and someone will point you to Marrow at a narrow credit office above the grain street. At 46, this Human has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. Marrow smiles with his mouth and not his eyes, and is rarely without velvet pouch of signed markers. Creditor to Tovin and Cal; employs Bask. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to own a seat on the town council through 'gifts'. What keeps them careful is the watch linking him to Bask's broken fingers. To a DM, Marrow is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Keeps a second book of debts the mayor would not want read aloud.

npcs.description: Pawnbroker associated with the pawn lattice window.
npcs.biography: Quinn Pawn works as a pawnbroker out of the pawn lattice window, a 41-year-old Human with more town memory than most council minutes. Quinn never asks names, always asks stories, and is rarely without tray of wedding rings with dates scratched out. Sometimes buys from Silk Mara; tip-toes around Rook. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to stay useful to everyone and owned by no one. What keeps them careful is fencing something that brings Serra's investigators. To a DM, Quinn is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Took in a watch badge filed smooth—and logged it under 'costume jewelry'.
